author: CharmaineRichardson
content: Authentic walking tour to visit Heaven’s Gate, Lonely Tree, Love Waterfall (an easy 35min walk one way - very doable for kids), then on to Silver Falls, lunch break in a very local village, followed by a lovely walk through the village, seeing the local life, houses, farms, rice paddy fields. The guide was knowledgeable, spoke decent English, and was very informative about the local culture. Highly recommended!

author: Subhasini
content: Tour truly to be recommended! (Family of 4 with two teenagers) We were Pro-actively contacted and asked / informed about 1. food and 2. What to bring - very much appreciated. All questions were answered upfront. Our tour guide Mr Sinh was amazing - best tour guide ever! He was so kind, very very knowledgeable, had the perfect pace in walking. We had sufficient time to enjoy the wonderful landscape, take pictures and enjoy. He made a perfect and tasty pick-nick for us at a place with an exceptional beautiful view - very well chosen. He was very thoughtful making the trip absolutely remarkable. His English is great! I would do the tour with him again any time and recommend him any time. I am sure I left out many details. We enjoyed the tour very much. Please keep on doing it as you do. Last but not least all was very well organized and went smoothly.
